prose: German energy company PreussenElektra is working with Nvidia to assess whether Germany's idle nuclear plants could be redeveloped as data centers, giving the shuttered sites new life while reactor dismantling continues, Bloomberg reports.
highlights: PreussenElektra and Nvidia assess turning idle German nuclear plants into data centers (Bloomberg)
